# Flowstate

> Flowstate is an Auckland company that builds AI automation for New Zealand trade businesses.

Flowstate (flowstate.net.nz) builds AI helpers on the software a trade business already uses: Fergus, Simpro, ServiceM8, AroFlo, Tradify and Xero. The AI drafts quotes, invoices, follow-ups and review requests, and the owner approves them. It starts with a free 30-minute call.
